description: Field templates for the consolidated statements of annual reports. The templates give no unit: the schema gives the reporting currency. The fields come from the request schema annual of the bench set requested. Draft: no route is measured.

cost_of_sales.description: Latest consolidated full-year cost of sales, positive amount. Do not substitute operating expenses.

gross_profit.description: Latest consolidated full-year gross profit as stated, preserving sign. Do not compute an unstated value.

revenue.description: Latest consolidated full-year revenue, in the reporting currency after its printed scale.

total_assets.description: Latest consolidated full-year closing total assets.

total_equity.description: Latest consolidated full-year closing total equity, preserving sign.

total_liabilities.description: Latest consolidated full-year closing total liabilities, preserving the printed sign.
